title: HPCL Rajasthan Refinery-cum-Petrochemical Complex inaugurated at Pachpadra
summary: Refinery and petrochemical complex in Barmer district.

title: Vadhavan Port to add 164 MTPA of capacity by 2030-31
summary: Flagship of a pipeline targeting over 700 MTPA of additional port capacity by 2030. Announced capacity, not built capacity.

title: Tuticorin Outer Harbour project to add 39 MTPA
summary: Part of the national port capacity pipeline to 2030.

title: Kandla Tuna Tekra terminal to contribute 33 MTPA by 2027-28
summary: Mega container terminal at Deendayal Port.

title: Rajnath Singh Asks DRDO to Integrate Production in Military Projects, Opens Defence Technology Lab in Hyderabad
summary: India's defence minister called for reducing development-to-production timelines in DRDO's research projects by integrating manufacturing plans, while hailing the indigenous defence technologies demonstrated by the armed forces during Operation Sindoor.

title: Cabinet approves ₹3,700 crore semiconductor plant in Uttar Pradesh
summary: Approval date is the report date; the underlying cabinet decision may differ by a few days.

title: New Zealand–India Free Trade Agreement signed
summary: Bilateral free trade agreement. Pinned to New Delhi as the Indian counterparty, not a project site.

title: Total exports reach a record US$863.11 billion in FY 2025-26
summary: Services $421.32bn (+8.71%); merchandise $441.78bn (+0.93%).

title: Major ports handle a record 915 million tonnes of cargo in FY 2025-26
summary: 7.06% growth, ahead of target. Pinned to the announcing ministry, not a single port.

title: Defence exports reach a record ₹38,424 crore in FY 2025-26
summary: Ministry of Defence announcement. The same figure backs the defence-exports chart series.

title: Ministry of Defence fully utilises its ₹1.86 lakh crore capital outlay
summary: Full utilisation of the modernisation budget, historically an area of chronic underspend.

title: Foundation stone laid for HCL-Foxconn joint venture, India Chip Pvt Ltd
summary: Display driver chip plant near the Noida International Airport site.

title: India successfully test-fires Agni-III intermediate-range ballistic missile
summary: Launched from the Integrated Test Range in Odisha.

title: India and the United States announce a reciprocal trade framework
summary: Framework for an interim agreement on reciprocal trade. Date is the month of announcement.

title: India–European Union Free Trade Agreement signed
summary: Described by the Commission as the largest trade agreement either side has concluded.
